name: plugin-audit
description: Generalized structural compliance check for any Claude Code plugin. Audits architectural decisions only — agent type appropriateness (markdown vs script), frontmatter compliance, eval coverage, and body line-count budgets. Use when adding or modifying any agent or skill in a plugin, after scaffolding a new plugin, before a migration PR lands, or for a periodic health check. Accepts any plugin directory path; not hardcoded to one plugin's internal structure.
